title: Studio Project Session v1
description: The conceptual current-session shape — one project, one design, per docs/bible/11-studio/254-project-session-model.md. PARTIAL: definitionHash/projectName/viewMode are each independently real (persisted or derivable); no runtime code assembles them into one object today.

definitionHash.description: Null until the first successful generation — the definitionHash of the currently-edited design is not computed client-side until the backend returns it.
